description:
The Operations Director needs a visual report of flight planning activity. Your task is to generate a bar chart showing the number of Flight Plans created per day.

1. Install the 'matplotlib' library (it is not currently installed).
2. Write a Python script at '/home/ga/generate_chart.py' that:
   - Connects to the Aerobridge Django database.
   - Queries all 'FlightPlan' records (from 'gcs_operations.models').
   - Aggregates the count of flight plans by their creation date.
   - Generates a bar chart (Date on X-axis, Count on Y-axis).
   - Saves the chart as a PNG image to '/home/ga/flight_activity.png'.
3. Execute your script to generate the image.

Note: You can assume the Aerobridge project path is '/opt/aerobridge'. You may need to set DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE to 'aerobridge.settings'.
